title: Position: Bayesian Statistics Facilitates Stakeholder Participation in Evaluation of Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes a general Bayesian statistical framework for evaluating bias by eliciting priors from stakeholders in minoritized communities. The methodology involves designing prompts for Generative AI models (LLMs/VLMs) and having domain-expert annotators evaluate the outputs (e.g., determining if outputs are harmful or affect specific identity groups) using qualitative, categorical, or continuous scales.
